vectors.name: level-3-reconcile: a coalition whose seats say level 2 is level 3, and its reconcile target, which would put one above it at level 4, is ignored
level-2-reconcile: the same reconcile target from a level-2 coalition opens as its motion, which its seats decide, keeping its public seat key and none of its secrets
genesis-level-4: a genesis whose seats say level 3 would found a level-4 coalition, so it is ignored, and so is everything after it
genesis-level-3: a genesis whose highest seat says level 2 founds a level-3 coalition
admit-level: an admitted seat takes the level its admit motion states, with the member groups it names, and the coalition rises to one above it; only this coalition’s log is read
admit-level-open: until its pass is final, an admit motion’s stated level doesn’t count, and the coalition stays at level 1
forgery-admit-level-4: an admit motion whose seat says level 3 would put this coalition at level 4, so it is ignored
forgery-admit-a-seat-here: an admit motion naming a seat this coalition already holds is ignored, whatever level it states
forgery-admit-own-seat-above: an admit motion naming this coalition’s own seat key in a coalition above it, from its reconcile motion, is ignored, so C can’t be seated inside itself

forgery-admit-raises-seated-level: while C’s motion to take a seat in Metro Renters is open, an admit motion whose seat says level 1 would raise C to level 2, a level higher than its seat there, so it is ignored (#549)

admit-raises-seated-level-at-final: an admit motion both seats pass opens before C’s motion to take a seat in Metro Renters; at its horizon C sits above, and the seat would raise its level, so it is refused there: it reads as a final fail, and C seats nobody and stays at level 1 (#549)
admit-raises-unseated-level: once C’s motion to take a seat in Metro Renters has failed, C sits nowhere above, so the same admit motion opens, passes and raises C to level 2 at its horizon (#549)
genesis-level-stated: a genesis that states C’s seat at C’s own level, 1, gets C’s pass once C’s reconcile motion is final, at its horizon, its deadline plus a day (#387)
genesis-level-misstated: a genesis that states C’s seat at level 0, when C is a level-1 coalition, gets C’s fail, though C passed its reconcile motion, final at its horizon (#387)
